positive.prompt: Build this Swift app and prove the development scheme launches in an iPhone simulator
Add an XCUITest target for our iOS acceptance scenarios without coupling the specs to screen details
xcodebuild succeeds but simctl cannot install the app; diagnose the simulator deployment
Choose the correct workspace, shared scheme, build configuration, and simulator destination for this Xcode project

negative.prompt: Inspect Chrome network requests to find why this React page renders blank
Write a failing unit test for this JavaScript currency rounding bug before changing the implementation

evals.prompt: The repository context is in project-context.md. Determine and execute as much of the simulator deployment verification as this environment supports. Report each build, install, launch, and test claim separately. Do not change application code.
evals.expected_output: Repository-driven Xcode discovery and deployment commands, with real evidence for attempted stages and an explicit blocker for any stage the environment cannot execute
expectations: The response discovers or attempts to discover the workspace, shared scheme, configuration, and available simulator rather than guessing them
Build, install, launch, and test are treated as separate claims
If Xcode or an iOS simulator is unavailable, the response reports the exact blocked stage and does not fabricate success
The response does not modify application code or dependency versions merely to force a result
